capabilities: Chat with coding agents that read, write, edit and search vault files
Edit selected text inline with word-level diff previews
Group sessions into projects with shared instructions and memory files
Invoke prompt templates and Skills with slash commands and reference files with @mentions
Connect external tools through agent-managed MCP servers
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Linux, Windows) and requires Obsidian v1.13.0+. The Plugin API is marked experimental and Collab has been split into a separate plugin, Claudian Collab. Troubleshooting and provider guides live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI coding agents that operate directly on vault files with search, file edits and bash.
